rounds.q: At top speed, how fast has the fastest human ever run, in mph?
rounds.why: Usain Bolt hit it mid-race in his 9.58-second 100-meter world record in 2009.
rounds.src: Int J Sports Medicine 2012; World Athletics (2009 race)
rounds.fun: 28 mph on just two legs! All packed into 9.58 seconds of pure zoom.

rounds.q: How many steps did the fastest 100-meter sprint ever take?
rounds.why: The other finalists needed about 45. Bolt's longest step was 2.87 meters, over 9 feet.
rounds.src: Bioengineering journal, 2023 study of the 2009 race
rounds.fun: Just 41 steps for 100 meters! Long legs, short count!

rounds.q: What was the average speed of the marathon world record, in mph?
rounds.why: Sabastian Sawe ran 1:59:30 in 2026, the first legal marathon under 2 hours.
rounds.src: World Athletics, Ratified world records, 23 Jul 2026 (2026 record)
rounds.fun: 13 mph for under 2 hours straight! Your guide is out of breath just reading it.

rounds.q: How many inches high is the men's high jump world record?
rounds.why: Javier Sotomayor set it in 1993, and nobody has beaten it in over 30 years.
rounds.src: World Athletics, all-time top list, men's high jump (1993 record)
rounds.fun: 96 inches is a full 8 feet! Sotomayor's bar has stayed on top since 1993. Wow!

rounds.q: What's the fastest tennis serve ever measured, in mph?
rounds.why: Sam Groth hit it in 2012. The fastest women's serve on record is 131 mph.
rounds.src: Guinness World Records, fastest serves (2012 and 2014)
rounds.fun: 163 mph! That beats the women's record by 32 mph. Duck!
